note_zh: BARD 在 Hooksiel 外海 Außenjade 的單部 5 MW 試驗機：Nordwest-Zeitung（2008-09-10，豎立期間）稱這部「Bard VM」輪轂高 90 m、葉輪直徑將近 122 m；Modern Power Systems（2008-09）寫輪轂在水面上 90 m、葉輪 122 m；同刊 2009-01（運轉後）與 Renewable Energy World（2008-11 落成報導）稱裝在水深 2～8 m 處。輪轂高度的出處都是施工期間的報導（不是事後竣工文件），供主會話判斷。
note_en: BARD's single 5 MW test turbine in the outer Jade off Hooksiel: Nordwest-Zeitung (10 Sep 2008, during erection) gives this 'Bard VM' a 90 m hub height and a rotor of just under 122 m; Modern Power Systems (Sep 2008) gives a hub 90 m above water level and a 122 m rotor; the same magazine (Jan 2009, after start-up) and Renewable Energy World (Nov 2008 inauguration report) put it in 2–8 m of water. The hub-height sources are construction-time reports, not a post-completion document; flagged for the main session.

sources.quote: Die Errichtung der „Bard VM“-Nearshore-Windkraftanlage in der Außenjade vor Hooksiel verläuft nach Plan … Die „Bard VM“ hat wie die späteren Anlagen im Offshore-Einsatz eine Nabenhöhe von 90 Metern, der Rotordurchmesser beträgt knapp 122 Meter.
The nacelle will be installed at a hub height of 90 m above water level, with a rotor diameter of 122 m.
Bard has installed its 5 MW VM-type training and demonstration wind energy converter in the outer Jade Estuary off Hooksiel, approximately 500 m from the shore in 2 to 8 m of water.
BARD Engineering GmbH inaugurated Germany’s first 5-megawatt (MW) near-shore wind turbine prototype in 2- to 8-meter deep water at Hooksiel off the German North Sea coast.

note_zh: DONG Energy 2017 年拆除新聞（Power Engineering 轉載）：11 部 0.45 MW 風機葉片長 17 m、輪轂高 37.5 m；Tethys 專案頁同為輪轂 37.5 m、水深 2.1～5.1 m。葉輪直徑未填：Tethys 寫 37 m，但丹麥能源署風機登記檔（Stamdataregister，xlsx，無法以 check_quotes 核對）每部都寫 35 m、輪轂 37.5 m，兩者不一致，暫不採用。

Rotor left empty: Tethys says 37 m, but the Danish Energy Agency's turbine register (Stamdataregister, an xlsx that check_quotes cannot read) gives 35 m (and a 37.5 m hub) for every unit, so the figures disagree.
why: Rotor diameter: Tethys 37 m conflicts with the DEA register's 35 m (not quotable); en.wikipedia infobox gives a unitless 'Rotor diameter 35' and a conflicting 'Hub height 35'.
